passed_definition: Archived evidence integrity, independently recomputed collection/selection arithmetic, quotations, and rejection decision are verified. This does not mean full protocol compliance or overall G0 passage.
scope: G0-A evidence collection, classification and numeric-input feasibility only. No forecast outputs, actual/target arrays or forecast scores were opened; no network or model calls were made by this verifier.
method: Independent stdlib HTML parsing, direct original source text inspection, regex numerical cross-check, SHA256 and git-object matching; no production review or forecasting module imported.

selected_semantic_review.145722: Observed initial outage with no preceding notice visible; does not prove historical first publication.
selected_semantic_review.145723: Explicit cancellation of the linked SA LOR2 forecast; no numerical reserve restoration value inferred.
selected_semantic_review.145724: Constraint activation explicitly cancelled by 145728; a change in market intervention status, not direct demand/price.
selected_semantic_review.145725: Single notice reports outage and restoration; under frozen coding convention this is observed initial, not a linked withdrawal.
selected_semantic_review.145754: Original scheduled end and earlier actual restoration both stated; revision, with secondary cross-day feature; prior plan not acquired.
selected_semantic_review.145758: Same reasoning as 145754 for Basslink; no capacity or price conversion inferred.

limitations: No external human gold or extraction-accuracy benchmark.
Secondary cross-day features exist although its primary quota is zero.
Request-start timestamps do not establish body-complete first-seen.

evidence_limits: Only engineering and evidence consistency were checked; no extraction accuracy, forecasting accuracy, calibration, or agent-over-fixed-rule increment was measured.

All six selected chains fail the frozen numeric input contract: no legal same-origin value correction and no verified same-semantic 72h history/24h mapping; 2026 notices cannot be attached to the 2022 smoke origin.
MW reserve forecasts are not demand_std; voltage kV is not MW; constraint names including ZERO are identifiers rather than numeric physical measurements; cancellation does not imply numeric zero.
Fixed rules can represent the explicit notice links and restoration/cancellation states checked here. Necessary LLM reasoning and superiority over a sound fixed pipeline were not demonstrated.
Historical publication timezone and first-seen remain unproved; directory/creation literal differences alone do not establish leakage.
Collection is partial due to predecessor 145307->145162 hitting the frozen six-node traversal cap. All 117 window candidates were obtained, but this is not complete historical coverage.
Selected prior-plan documents for 145754/145758 are absent. Chain counts are not counts of independent physical events.
Primary cross_day count zero reflects category priority; four reviewed chains have a secondary cross_day feature.
This STOP applies only to the frozen source/origin/schema combination and is not a negative test of all news or agent forecasting approaches.
Base CPU smoke verification is separate and is not claimed as part of this evidence report.

independent_final_check_resources.measurement_scope: Final numeric/hash consolidation only; preceding collection and manual independent read-only review were not timed.
